title: HimmBO: High-Dimensional Interactive Model-Merging Bayesian Optimization for Image Generation
title_zh: HimmBO：面向图像生成的高维交互式模型合并贝叶斯优化

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning has become a common way to customize text-to-image models, leading to community collections of over 100K lightweight adapters. Adapters sharing a base model can be merged with continuous coefficients. This turns a large collection into a high-dimensional continuous design space, which recent work explores interactively using preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO). However, existing approaches are limited to a few dozen preselected adapters and require expensive image generation in every interaction round. We introduce HimmBO, a two-stage method that scales preference-driven adapter merging to much larger collections while reducing image-generation cost. Its screening stage recovers the active adapter set through level-set estimation over pre-generated images, requiring no image generation. The refinement stage then optimizes merge coefficients in the recovered low-dimensional subspace. Both stages use a style-aware kernel, allowing preference information to transfer between visually similar adapters. In simulated-user image-matching experiments, HimmBO achieves higher final similarity than all comparisons while reaching a given similarity with under one tenth of the image generations required by prior work. Its performance remains stable as the collection grows to 1080 adapters, while competing methods degrade substantially.

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning has become a common way to customize text-to-image diffusion models for particular subjects, appearances, and artistic styles [ HSW∗22 , RLJ∗23 , ZSY∗24 ] . The lightweight nature of parameter-efficient adaptations such as LoRA has also encouraged online communities to build and share large collections of fine-tuned models, which we refer to broadly as adapters . Beyond using adapters individually, users can also perform operations over multiple adapters to create new models and visual effects. One such operation, and the focus of this work, is adapter merging , where multiple adapters are combined with user-specified coefficients to produce a hybrid model that reflects their respective contributions [ IRW∗23 ] . This turns a collection of N N adapters into an N N -dimensional continuous design space (Fig. 1 ). Even interfaces exposing only a handful of coefficients become difficult to operate as the number of parameters grows, with prior studies reporting substantial degradation beyond roughly 5–10 sliders [ DMB22 ] . As community adapter collections continue to grow, with over 100K adapters on Civitai alone [ LWT∗24 , SZY25 ] , directly exploring the resulting space becomes increasingly impractical.

paragraphs.en: Selecting such coefficients can be viewed as optimizing a black-box user-preference function over the adapter-merging space. GimmBO [ LLJ26 ] recently showed that preferential Bayesian optimization (BO) can solve this problem interactively for roughly 20–30 candidate adapters within 20 interaction rounds. However, two practical limitations remain: each iteration requires computationally expensive image generation, and the candidate set must already be reduced to only a few dozen adapters. Unlike conventional BO applications with near-instantaneous evaluations [ KSSI17 , KSG20 ] , image generation makes even 20 rounds costly in wall-clock time, from minutes to hours depending on hardware or service (inset). Obtaining such a small candidate set requires either manual curation or an external retrieval system [ LWT∗24 , SZY25 ] , adding user effort in the former case and requiring a sufficiently accurate language description in the latter. Our goal is thus to make preference-driven exploration practical over much larger adapter collections while reducing the image-generation cost.

paragraphs.en: We introduce HimmBO, a preference-driven optimization method that scales well with candidate adapter set size while remaining image-generation efficient. HimmBO builds on GimmBO’s two-stage strategy, which runs BO over all adapter coefficients inside a capped simplex that keeps merges sparse, reads the active set off the best merge found so far, then restarts BO in the lower-dimensional space those adapters define [ LLJ26 ] . At higher dimensions, this strategy becomes error-prone because the second refinement stage relies on the sparsity pattern of a single tentative optimum. Our key insight is that screening need not identify the optimum itself, but only reliably recover the active adapter set (Sec. 4.3.2 ). We explore several alternative Bayesian formulations for screening, including active learning (AL) and level-set estimation (LSE), which consider a broader portion of the preference landscape rather than concentrating on a single optimum. We ultimately select LSE, which most accurately recovers the active adapters by drawing on multiple promising samples (Sec. 5.1.3 ). Crucially, LSE also admits a pool-based setting in which candidates are selected from a fixed sample library rather than generated dynamically during optimization. This allows us to pre-generate the corresponding images as a gallery , eliminating image-generation wait time during screening (Sec. 4.3.1 ). Finally, different adapters can produce similar visual results, so preference for one can inform preference for another similar adapter. We capture this relationship with a style kernel to further improve performance (Sec. 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HimmBO，这是一种偏好驱动的优化方法，能随候选适配器集合规模的扩大而良好扩展，同时保持图像生成的高效性。 HimmBO 建立在 GimmBO 的两阶段策略之上：该策略在一个保持合并稀疏性的封顶单纯形内对所有适配器系数运行 BO，从目前找到的最佳合并中读出活跃集，然后在这些适配体所定义的低维空间中重新启动 BO [ LLJ26 ]。 在更高维度下，这一策略变得容易出错，因为第二阶段的精细化依赖于单个试探性最优解的稀疏模式。 我们的关键洞见是：筛选无需识别最优解本身，而只需可靠地恢复活跃适配器集合（第 4.3.2 节）。 我们探索了若干用于筛选的替代性贝叶斯公式，包括主动学习（AL）和水平集估计（LSE），它们考虑偏好景观的更大部分，而不是集中于单个最优解。 我们最终选择了 LSE，它通过利用多个有希望的样本，最准确地恢复活跃适配器（第 5.1.3 节）。 至关重要的是，LSE 还支持一种基于池的设置，其中候选者从固定的样本库中选取，而不是在优化过程中动态生成。 这使我们能够预先生成对应的图像作为图库，从而消除筛选过程中的图像生成等待时间（第 4.3.1 节）。 最后，不同的适配器可能产生相似的视觉结果，因此对某个适配器的偏好可以为对另一个相似适配器的偏好提供信息。 我们用风格核来刻画这种关系，以进一步提升性能（第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate HimmBO through quantitative simulated-user experiments on image-matching tasks, following GimmBO’s evaluation protocol [ LLJ26 ] (Sec. 5 ). In addition to final image similarity and ground-truth active-adapter recovery, we evaluate scalability and image-generation cost. To test scalability, we increase the adapter collection size from N = 40 N=40 to 120 120 , 360 360 , 720 720 , and 1080 1080 . HimmBO degrades gracefully with library size, reaching 0.889 0.889 similarity at N = 1080 N=1080 , only 0.018 0.018 below its 0.907 0.907 at N = 40 N=40 . In contrast, the best alternative drops sharply from 0.903 0.903 at N = 40 N=40 to 0.828 0.828 at N = 1080 N=1080 , and GimmBO itself to 0.762 0.762 . HimmBO is also substantially more generation-efficient, reaching 0.80 0.80 similarity with 6.8 % 6.8\% of the image generations GimmBO needs to reach the same level. Together, these results extend preference-driven model merging from a small, pre-curated adapter set to collections approaching the scale of contemporary community model libraries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 GimmBO 的评估协议 [ LLJ26 ]（第 5 节），通过在图像匹配任务上进行定量模拟用户实验来评估 HimmBO。 除了最终图像相似度和真实活跃适配器恢复之外，我们还评估了可扩展性和图像生成成本。 为了测试可扩展性，我们将适配器集合规模从 N = 40 增加到 120、360、720 和 1080。 HimmBO 随库规模增长而优雅退化，在 N = 1080 时达到 0.889 的相似度，仅比其在 N = 40 时的 0.907 低 0.018。 相比之下，最佳替代方法从 N = 40 时的 0.903 骤降至 N = 1080 时的 0.828，而 GimmBO 本身也降至 0.762。 HimmBO 在生成效率上也显著更高，达到 0.80 相似度所需的图像生成次数仅为 GimmBO 达到相同水平所需次数的 6.8%。 总之，这些结果将偏好驱动的模型合并从一个小型、预先策划的适配器集合扩展到了接近当代社区模型库规模的大型集合。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models generate images by gradually denoising random noise [ HJA20 , RBL∗22 ] , with large open models such as SDXL [ PEL∗24 ] serving as bases for much of the surrounding community ecosystem. Adapters are weight updates trained on top of such a base to add a subject or style [ RLJ∗23 , ZWH∗25 , ZSY∗24 ] , including popular parameter-efficient forms such as LoRA [ HSW∗22 ] . Because they can be trained from only a handful of images and are cheap to store and share, community collections now contain over 100K adapters [ LWT∗24 , SZY25 ] . Adapters from the same base can be combined by adding their weight updates, following a long history of weight averaging across related models [ IPG∗18 , WIG∗22 ] . This works because fine-tuned models often remain in the same low-loss region, allowing their updates to be added and scaled [ FDRC20 , IRW∗23 ] . When updates interfere, more elaborate rules can reweight or sparsify them [ MR22 , YTC∗23 , YYY∗24 ] , but simple linear merging is what community tools commonly implement and what we use as well (Sec. 3 ). In image generation, merging is usually applied to a small, fixed set of adapters to compose several concepts or combine a subject with a style [ GWW∗23 , PYAW24 , DYY25 , SRC∗24 , FVSCO24 , OLH25 ] . These methods assume the participating adapters are given in advance, with coefficients either fixed by the method or fitted to a predefined target. GimmBO instead treats the coefficients as a search problem, using user preference comparisons in place of an explicit target [ LLJ26 ] . Its candidate set, however, is still small and chosen beforehand. Our work extends this interactive search from a small preselected set to an entire adapter library.

paragraphs.en: When a collection contains hundreds or thousands of adapters, a common first step is to retrieve a small subset relevant to the user’s query. Stylus retrieves adapters from a text query [ LWT∗24 ] , while LoRAverse additionally promotes coverage across the collection [ SZY25 ] . Other work retrieves directly from model weights, either using them as style descriptors [ LTJ24 ] or aligning them with text for prompt-based retrieval [ LDC∗25 ] . Similar ideas apply to language adapters, using a task loss or a few examples instead of a prompt [ HLL∗24 , ZGW∗24 , CPFD23 ] . These methods choose the adapter set once from a query specified before search begins, which may be difficult for users who cannot yet state their preference explicitly. We therefore make adapter selection part of the interactive loop and compare against retrieval for the same task (Sec. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 当一个集合包含成百上千个适配器时，一个常见的第一步是检索出与用户查询相关的一小部分适配器。 Stylus 从文本查询中检索适配器 [ LWT∗24 ]，而 LoRAverse 还额外促进了整个集合的覆盖 [ SZY25 ]。 其他工作直接从模型权重进行检索，或者将它们用作风格描述符 [ LTJ24 ]，或者将它们与文本对齐以进行基于提示的检索 [ LDC∗25 ]。 类似的想法也适用于语言智能体，使用任务损失或少量示例来代替提示 [ HLL∗24 , ZGW∗24 , CPFD23 ]。 这些方法只根据搜索开始前指定的查询一次性选择适配器集合，这对于尚无法明确表达偏好的用户来说可能很困难。 因此，我们将适配器选择纳入交互循环中，并针对同一任务与检索方法进行比较（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: When quality is subjective, users must remain in the loop, and prior work has explored interfaces such as sliders and galleries. Direct slider control becomes difficult beyond roughly five to ten parameters [ DMB22 ] , while systems that learn subjective quality from human judgments still operate below the dimensionality we target [ KSI14 , DAM∗19 , SFP∗20 ] . Galleries instead present outputs rather than parameters, either arranging samples from the design space for browsing [ MAB∗97 , NDM06 , SSCO09 ] or selecting from a fixed image database based on the user’s choices [ CMM∗00 ] . They can remain responsive by precomputing expensive results and reusing them during interaction [ SSM15 , SXZ∗17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当质量是主观的时候，用户必须始终参与其中，以往的工作已经探索了滑块和图库等交互界面。 当参数超过大约五到十个时，直接滑块控制就会变得困难 [ DMB22 ]，而那些从人类判断中学习主观质量的系统，其可处理的维度仍低于我们的目标维度 [ KSI14 , DAM∗19 , SFP∗20 ]。 图库则展示输出而非参数，或者排列设计空间中的样本以供浏览 [ MAB∗97 , NDM06 , SSCO09 ]，或者根据用户的选择从固定的图像数据库中进行选取 [ CMM∗00 ]。 它们可以通过预先计算开销较大的结果并在交互过程中复用这些结果来保持响应性 [ SSM15 , SXZ∗17 ]。

paragraphs.en: BO provides a sample-efficient backend for human-in-the-loop design [ BBdF10 , KSSI17 , KSG20 ] and has been applied to domains such as melodies, fonts, and game levels [ ZKGI20 , KKR21 , TSD∗25 , KRL∗16 ] , alongside work on how users and optimization systems cooperate [ KG22 , MDC∗24 , NYKU25 ] . These methods typically propose new parameter settings each round, so their outputs must be generated during interaction rather than fully precomputed. GimmBO falls into this category [ LLJ26 ] , and our refinement stage similarly returns to continuous BO once the candidate adapters have been reduced. However, screening has a different goal: rather than finding a single optimum, it must identify a set of promising adapters across the preference landscape. We use pool-based level-set estimation (LSE) for screening to achieve better active-adapter recovery while allowing all screening images to be precomputed (Sec. 4.3.1 & 5.1.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 贝叶斯优化（BO）为人在回路的设计提供了样本高效的后端 [ BBdF10 , KSSI17 , KSG20 ]，并已被应用于旋律、字体和游戏关卡等领域 [ ZKGI20 , KKR21 , TSD∗25 , KRL∗16 ]，同时也有关于用户与优化系统如何协作的研究 [ KG22 , MDC∗24 , NYKU25 ]。 这些方法通常每一轮都会提出新的参数设置，因此其输出必须在交互过程中生成，而无法完全预先计算。 GimmBO 属于这一类 [ LLJ26 ]，而在筛选出候选适配器之后，我们的细化阶段同样会回到连续的贝叶斯优化。 然而，筛选有着不同的目标：它不是要寻找单一的最优解，而是要在偏好空间中识别出一组有前景的适配器。 我们采用基于候选池的水平集估计（LSE）进行筛选，以更好地恢复活跃适配器，同时允许所有筛选图像被预先计算（第 4.3.1 节与 5.1.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The human-in-the-loop methods above are examples of goal-driven learning, where each query is chosen from the current surrogate to serve a particular objective [ DFNM24 , PAS26 ] . BO seeks a single best point [ SKKS10 ] , AL an accurate surrogate through uncertainty- or information-based queries [ Mac92 , SWGO00 , HHGL11 , BHGL19 ] , and LSE the set of candidates above a level [ BNG∗05 , GCHK13 , BSKC16 ] . LSE therefore best suits our screening stage, which recovers a set of promising adapters rather than a single optimum (Sec. 5.1.3 ). With preferential rather than scalar feedback, latent utility can be modeled with a probit likelihood [ CG05 ] , with preferential Bayesian optimization defining acquisition rules on this model [ GDDL17 , ALBF23 ] . For batched queries, diversity may be implicit or explicitly encouraged, for example with determinantal point processes [ KT12 , KDK16 ] . Large adapter libraries also introduce high dimensionality, addressed by prior work through linear embeddings [ WHZ∗16 , RWB∗20 , CKL∗20 ] , trust regions [ DPLRSDP23 ] , or sparse coordinate selection [ EJ21 , LFE∗23 ] . These strategies can ease search in a high-dimensional coefficient space, but its dimension still grows linearly with the number of adapters. We instead use a fixed-dimensional style space where nearby adapters share feedback (Sec. 3 ).

paragraphs.en: GimmBO [ LLJ26 ] turns the choice of 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} into an interactive loop: each round it generates a batch of candidate merges, the user ranks the images, the ranking updates a surrogate function of the user’s preference over 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} , and an acquisition function picks the next batch. This works well when the candidate set is small and curated, typically 20–30 adapters chosen beforehand. Public collections, however, contain thousands of adapters, so users must solve a more fundamental problem before tuning coefficients: deciding which adapters to use in the first place. We build on two observations to extend the same interactive loop to answer both questions.
paragraphs.zh: GimmBO [LLJ26] 将 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} 的选择转化为一个交互式循环：每一轮它会生成一批候选合并结果，用户对图像进行排序，该排序会更新一个关于用户对 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} 偏好的代理函数，然后由采集函数选出下一批候选。 当候选集较小且经过筛选时，这一方法效果很好，通常是事先挑选出的 20–30 个适配器。 然而，公开合集包含数千个适配器，因此用户在调整系数之前必须先解决一个更根本的问题：决定首先使用哪些适配器。 我们基于两点观察来扩展同一交互式循环，以同时回答这两个问题。

paragraphs.en: A user who merges style adapters rarely has a single look in mind: the same user may find a woodblock print, a photograph, and an oil painting all close to what they want (inset), producing several distinct peaks of preference across the library. A search for a single best point can lock onto whichever peak is favored by its first few comparisons and keep querying there, especially in the high-dimensional setting we target, where only a small fraction of the space can be explored. Such a miss is silent—a user who never sees a style cannot ask for more of it—and can exclude adapters needed for a final merge spanning several peaks. Unlike GimmBO, whose first screening stage relies on a single tentative optimum and often captures only one peak, our search seeks broader coverage by identifying a set of promising points spanning multiple peaks (Sec. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 合并风格适配器的用户心中很少只有一个明确的目标样式：同一用户可能觉得木刻版画、照片和油画都接近其想要的效果（插图），从而在整个库中产生多个不同的偏好峰值。 只搜索单一最优点的做法可能锁定在其最初几次比较所偏好的那个峰值上并持续在该处查询，尤其在我们针对的高维设置中，空间中只有很小一部分能被探索到。 这种遗漏是无声的——用户从未见过某种样式，就无法要求更多这样的样式——并且可能排除跨多个峰值的最终合并所需的适配器。 与 GimmBO 不同——其第一轮筛选依赖于一个临时最优解，往往只能捕捉到一个峰值——我们的搜索通过识别一组横跨多个峰值的有希望的点来寻求更广的覆盖（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Users judge generated images by appearance, and visually similar styles occur throughout large adapter libraries. Independently trained adapters can produce nearly indistinguishable looks (Fig. 3 , top). Yet coefficient space does not capture this structure because each adapter occupies its own axis, making all pairs equally distant regardless of visual similarity and preventing a preference model over 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} from transferring feedback to lookalikes. The feedback required therefore grows with the number of adapters. We instead model preference in a style space measured from generated images, allowing feedback on one adapter to inform others with similar styles.
paragraphs.zh: 用户通过外观来评判生成的图像，而视觉上相似的风格会大量出现在适配器库中。 独立训练的适配器可以产生几乎无法区分的外观（图 3，上）。 然而系数空间无法捕捉这种结构，因为每个适配器占据自己的轴，使得所有配对的距离都相同，无论视觉相似与否，从而导致关于 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} 的偏好模型无法将反馈迁移到相似外观的适配器上。 因此所需的反馈量会随适配器数量的增加而增长。 我们转而在从生成图像中测得的风格空间中建模偏好，使得针对某个适配器的反馈可以作用于风格相似的其他适配器。

paragraphs.en: Our answer is a single preference posterior driving two stages, shaped by the two observations in Sec. 3 . The screening stage searches the full library for a small active set covering styles the user may still prefer, rather than committing to a single tentative optimum. paragraphs.en: Thus, the coefficients affect preference only through the appearance of the image they produce. We construct Φ \Phi from perceptual image features by centering features within each prompt to suppress shared content and composition, then normalizing and projecting with PCA (details in App. A.2 ). The perceptual encoder is interchangeable, and we use DreamSim [ FTS∗23 ] by default (alternative encoders are compared in App. C ). Its output dimension is fixed with respect to library size, and PCA further compresses it using a fixed variance threshold, yielding a small dimension d d that changes little as N N grows. During screening, gallery images are pre-generated, so 𝐳 \mathbf{z} is measured directly with Φ \Phi . During refinement, 𝐳 \mathbf{z} is predicted from 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} for acquisition and then measured directly once the proposed merge is generated (Sec. 4.3.3 ).

paragraphs.en: HimmBO separates the search into two stages with distinct goals (inset). Screening searches the full library to identify an active set of m m adapters from the N N candidates, while refinement continuously optimizes the merge coefficients within that set. Because refinement cannot recover adapters omitted from this set, screening must cover promising regions rather than identify a single optimum. paragraphs.en: Both AL and LSE admit a pool-based setting, where queries are selected from a fixed candidate set. We instantiate the pool with one unit-strength sample per adapter, with its gallery and style feature 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} precomputed as in Sec. 4.3.1 . paragraphs.en: These objectives produce different query patterns (Fig. 5 ). BO can concentrate around an early peak, leaving others unexplored. This is especially problematic in high dimensions, where a limited budget may miss peaks containing adapters needed by the final merge. AL covers the landscape broadly but spends queries in low-utility regions the user has rejected. LSE instead concentrates on uncertain level-set membership around multiple promising peaks, retaining candidates estimated above the level. Both AL and LSE recover the active set more accurately than BO as the library grows; LSE performs best and is used in our method (Sec. 5.1.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些目标会产生不同的查询模式（图5）。 贝叶斯优化（BO）可能会集中在一个早期峰值附近，而使其余峰值未被探索。 这在高维情况下尤其成问题，因为有限的预算可能会错过包含最终合并所需适配器的峰值。 主动学习（AL）能广泛覆盖整个搜索空间，但会把查询花费在用户已拒绝的低效用区域。 水平集估计（LSE）则将精力集中在多个有前景峰值周围不确定的水平集归属上，保留被估计为高于水平的候选者。 随着库的增大，主动学习和水平集估计都比贝叶斯优化更准确地恢复活跃集；水平集估计表现最佳，并被用于我们的方法中（第5.1.3节）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate HimmBO with a matching task, a standard protocol for human-in-the-loop optimization [ BBdF10 , KSSI17 , KSG20 , LLJ26 ] . We construct 24 test target images with different prompts, each generated from a hidden merge of multiple library adapters with strengths ∑ i α i \sum_{i}\alpha_{i} drawn from the empirical distribution observed in community merges. For each ground-truth (GT) target, the simulated user judges the similarity of candidate images generated with the same prompt to the GT and provides only preference feedback to the method. We evaluate on each target over five random seeds. The simulated user evaluates each shown image by its similarity to I GT I_{\mathrm{GT}} , using DreamSim [ FTS∗23 ] as the preference function, f ⁡ ( I ⁡ ( 𝜶 ) , I GT ) = DreamSim ⁡ ( I ⁡ ( 𝜶 ) , I GT ) f(I(\bm{\alpha}),I_{\mathrm{GT}})=\mathrm{DreamSim}(I(\bm{\alpha}),I_{\mathrm{GT}}) , following GimmBO’s simulated-user protocol [ LLJ26 ] . During screening, we run T 1 = 12 T_{1}{=}12 rounds with q = 8 q{=}8 precomputed gallery images per round, and the user selects the c = 4 c{=}4 most similar. Because screening operates entirely on precomputed galleries, these 12 rounds collect preference feedback without any new image generation. During refinement, we run T 2 = 8 T_{2}{=}8 rounds, each generating q = 8 q{=}8 merges and showing them alongside the previous round’s best, from which the user ranks the top five. We set these budgets taking user-facing cost into account, rather than performance saturation alone: screening mainly costs interaction effort, whereas refinement also incurs waiting time for image generation. This gives 64 inferences per session, versus 165 in GimmBO’s published configuration. Because image generation dominates latency and all other computation takes only seconds on the CPU, the lower inference budget directly reduces the user’s waiting time. A session then takes about 15 15 minutes versus 37 37 for GimmBO on a single GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个匹配任务来评估 HimmBO，这是人在回路优化的标准协议 [ BBdF10 , KSSI17 , KSG20 , LLJ26 ] 。 我们使用不同的提示词构建了 24 张测试目标图像，每张图像均由多个库适配器的隐藏合并生成，其强度 ∑ i α i \sum_{i}\alpha_{i} 取自社区合并中观察到的经验分布。 对于每个真值（GT）目标，模拟用户判断由相同提示词生成的候选图像与 GT 的相似度，并仅向方法提供偏好反馈。 我们在每个目标上进行五个随机种子的评估。 模拟用户根据每张展示图像与 I GT I_{\mathrm{GT}} 的相似度进行评估，采用 DreamSim [ FTS∗23 ] 作为偏好函数，即 f ⁡ ( I ⁡ ( 𝜶 ) , I GT ) = DreamSim ⁡ ( I ⁡ ( 𝜶 ) , I GT ) f(I(\bm{\alpha}),I_{\mathrm{GT}})=\mathrm{DreamSim}(I(\bm{\alpha}),I_{\mathrm{GT}}) ，遵循 GimmBO 的模拟用户协议 [ LLJ26 ] 。 在筛选阶段，我们运行 T 1 = 12 T_{1}{=}12 轮，每轮使用 q = 8 q{=}8 张预计算的画廊图像，用户从中选出最相似的 c = 4 c{=}4 张。 由于筛选完全基于预计算的画廊进行，这 12 轮在不进行任何新图像生成的情况下收集偏好反馈。 在细化阶段，我们运行 T 2 = 8 T_{2}{=}8 轮，每轮生成 q = 8 q{=}8 个合并结果，并将其与上一轮的最佳结果一同展示，用户从中排出前五名。 我们在设定这些预算时考虑了用户侧的成本，而不仅仅是性能饱和：筛选主要消耗交互精力，而细化还会产生等待图像生成的时间。 这使得每次会话进行 64 次推理，而 GimmBO 已发布的配置为 165 次。 由于图像生成主导了延迟，而所有其他计算在 CPU 上仅需数秒，因此更低的推理预算直接减少了用户的等待时间。 在单块 GPU 上，一次会话大约需要 15 15 分钟，而 GimmBO 则需要 37 37 分钟。

paragraphs.en: We curate SDXL-Style-1K , a library of 1,080 SDXL LoRA style adapters. We crawl public SDXL adapters on Civitai, filter them by tags and usage statistics, use a language model to verify that each changes style rather than content, and manually inspect standardized generations (App. B.1 ). We generate each adapter’s gallery once before interaction, using four fixed subjects with one image per subject. For scalability experiments, we form nested libraries of N = 40 N{=}40 , 120, 360, 720, and 1080 adapters, each containing all smaller libraries. Our main performance analysis uses the N = 360 N{=}360 library, while Sec. 5.1.2 evaluates performance across library sizes. We will release the library manifest, curation pipeline, and test inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 SDXL-Style-1K，这是一个包含 1,080 个 SDXL LoRA 风格适配器的库。 我们爬取 Civitai 上的公开 SDXL 适配器，按标签和使用统计进行筛选，用语言模型验证每个适配器改变的是风格而非内容，并人工检查标准化生成结果（附录 B.1）。 我们在交互开始前为每个适配器生成一次图库，使用四个固定的主体，每个主体生成一张图像。 在可扩展性实验中，我们构建了嵌套的适配器库，规模分别为 N{=}40、120、360、720 和 1080，其中每个较大的库都包含所有较小的库。 我们的主要性能分析使用 N{=}360 的库，而第 5.1.2 节评估了不同库规模下的性能。 我们将发布该库的清单、筛选流程以及测试输入。

sents.zh: 我们在交互开始前为每个适配器生成一次图库，使用四个固定的主体，每个主体生成一张图像。

sents.en: For scalability experiments, we form nested libraries of N = 40 N{=}40 , 120, 360, 720, and 1080 adapters, each containing all smaller libraries.
sents.zh: 在可扩展性实验中，我们构建了嵌套的适配器库，规模分别为 N{=}40、120、360、720 和 1080，其中每个较大的库都包含所有较小的库。

sents.en: Our main performance analysis uses the N = 360 N{=}360 library, while Sec. 5.1.2 evaluates performance across library sizes.
sents.zh: 我们的主要性能分析使用 N{=}360 的库，而第 5.1.2 节评估了不同库规模下的性能。

sents.en: We will release the library manifest, curation pipeline, and test inputs.
sents.zh: 我们将发布该库的清单、筛选流程以及测试输入。

paragraphs.en: We compare HimmBO against GimmBO, retrieval-based alternatives, and a slider-style baseline. We evaluate GimmBO directly on the test library using its published configuration. For retrieval, we use Stylus [ LWT∗24 ] , which retrieves adapters from text. To adapt it to our image-matching task, we caption the target GT with a vision-language model and use that caption as the query, giving Stylus additional GT information unavailable to other methods. At each round, we rerun Stylus with a new random seed to produce a new image batch, from which the user keeps the best. We also include Stylus+GimmBO, following GimmBO’s retrieval extension [ LLJ26 ] : Stylus retrieves the top 40 adapters, then GimmBO runs its full method on this reduced set. For the slider-style baseline, we include random coordinate descent, which adjusts one coefficient at a time over eight evenly spaced values. We omit other slider-style baselines because they already performed poorly at N = 20 N{=}20 [ LLJ26 ] and degrade further as N N grows. GimmBO and random coordinate descent share the same five initial images and thus start from the same point; the remaining methods start from candidates produced by screening or retrieval. Stylus and random coordinate descent evaluate eight candidates per round to match HimmBO’s batch size, while GimmBO retains its published interaction protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 HimmBO 与 GimmBO、基于检索的替代方法以及滑块式基线进行比较。 我们使用 GimmBO 已发布的配置直接在测试库上对其进行评估。 对于检索，我们使用 Stylus [ LWT∗24 ]，它从文本中检索适配器。 为了将其适配到我们的图像匹配任务中，我们用视觉-语言模型对目标 GT 进行描述，并将该描述作为查询，从而为 Stylus 提供其他方法无法获得的额外 GT 信息。 在每一轮中，我们用新的随机种子重新运行 Stylus 以生成新的一批图像，用户从中保留最好的图像。 我们还包含 Stylus+GimmBO，遵循 GimmBO 的检索扩展 [ LLJ26 ]：Stylus 检索出前 40 个适配器，然后 GimmBO 在这个缩减的集合上运行其完整方法。 对于滑块式基线，我们纳入随机坐标下降，它在八个均匀间隔的取值上每次调整一个系数。 我们省略其他滑块式基线，因为它们在 N = 20 N{=}20 时已经表现不佳 [ LLJ26 ]，并且随着 N N 的增大性能进一步下降。 GimmBO 和随机坐标下降共享相同的五张初始图像，因此从同一起点开始；其余方法从通过筛选或检索得到的候选图像开始。 Stylus 和随机坐标下降每轮评估八个候选图像，以匹配 HimmBO 的批次大小，而 GimmBO 保留其已发布的交互协议。

paragraphs.en: Similarity is measured by DreamSim [ FTS∗23 ] between the final generated image and the GT, following GimmBO [ LLJ26 ] . Scores of 0.9 0.9 and 0.95 0.95 correspond roughly to a match and a near-exact match, respectively. Sparsity recovery is measured by the F1 score between the adapters active in the final merge and the GT’s true components [ LLJ26 ] . It penalizes both missed and redundant adapters, distinguishing whether a method recovers the true components or instead matches the GT using visually similar alternatives. The style map uses DreamSim by default, but HimmBO still outperforms GimmBO when both it and the simulated user use other encoders, such as TPIPS [ WNH∗26 ] (App. C ).
paragraphs.zh: 按照 GimmBO [ LLJ26 ] 的做法，相似度通过 DreamSim [ FTS∗23 ] 在最终生成的图像与 GT 之间度量。 0.9 0.9 和 0.95 0.95 的分数大致分别对应于匹配和近乎完全匹配。 稀疏性恢复通过最终合并中激活的适配器与 GT 的真实组件之间的 F1 分数来度量 [ LLJ26 ] 。 它同时惩罚遗漏和冗余的适配器，从而区分一种方法是恢复了真实组件，还是转而使用视觉上相似的替代物来匹配 GT。 风格图默认使用 DreamSim，但当它和模拟用户都使用其他编码器（如 TPIPS [ WNH∗26 ] ）时，HimmBO 仍然优于 GimmBO（附录 C ）。

paragraphs.en: We set up the simulated user to see the hidden GT image and judge candidate images by DreamSim similarity, while the method receives only the resulting preference feedback, following GimmBO’s matching protocol. We analyze each session in two ways (Fig. 6 , left). First, we plot similarity against feedback rounds, measuring the user interaction budget. To visualize screening progress, after each round we read out the current active set, generate one batch of q = 8 q{=}8 merges using the refinement acquisition on the feedback so far, and plot the best result (hollow dots). These diagnostic generations are excluded from HimmBO’s inference budget. Second, we plot the same progress against inferences, which captures the main source of user waiting time. GimmBO evaluates efficiency in rounds, capturing interaction effort but not inference-induced waiting time. HimmBO separates these costs: screening advances the round count using precomputed images without spending inferences, so the two axes differ.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将模拟用户设置为能够看到隐藏的真实（GT）图像，并通过 DreamSim 相似度来判断候选图像，而方法本身只接收由此产生的偏好反馈，遵循 GimmBO 的匹配协议。 我们从两个方面对每个会话进行分析（图 6，左）。 首先，我们绘制相似度随反馈轮次变化的曲线，以衡量用户交互预算。 为了可视化筛选进度，在每一轮之后，我们读取当前的活跃集，基于迄今为止的反馈使用精细化采集函数生成一批 q = 8 q{=}8 的合并结果，并绘制最佳结果（空心点）。 这些诊断性生成不计入 HimmBO 的推理预算。 其次，我们绘制同样的进度随推理次数变化的曲线，以刻画用户等待时间的主要来源。 GimmBO 以轮次来评估效率，这捕捉了交互开销，却未捕捉推理引起的等待时间。 HimmBO 将这两种开销分开：筛选通过预先计算的图像推进轮次计数而不消耗推理，因此两个坐标轴有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Against rounds, HimmBO improves steadily through screening, passes GimmBO before screening ends, and overtakes Stylus+GimmBO shortly after refinement begins, reaching the highest final similarity. Stylus+GimmBO is the strongest alternative and benefits from GT-derived auto-captioning for retrieval. Stylus alone starts strongly but quickly plateaus around 0.80 0.80 , while GimmBO improves more gradually and random coordinate descent remains lowest. Against inferences, the ordering is similar, but HimmBO’s advantage is clearer because screening requires no image generation. HimmBO reaches 0.80 0.80 after only 8 inferences, compared with 53 for Stylus+GimmBO and 117 for GimmBO; Stylus and random coordinate descent never reach this level. A HimmBO session stops after 64 inferences, and the dashed continuation shows further improvement under the same inference budget as the comparisons. Sparsity recovery further explains these differences. HimmBO recovers the most GT adapters, followed by Stylus+GimmBO, whose subsequent search cannot recover components missed by Stylus. Stylus alone recovers some GT components, whereas GimmBO recovers almost none despite moderate image similarity. Instead, GimmBO boosts visually similar alternatives to approach the target, but at N = 360 N{=}360 still stalls short of a match. This reflects the style-space observation of Sec. 3 : visually similar adapters can produce similar images even when the recovered active set is wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 相对于轮数而言，HimmBO 在筛选阶段持续稳步提升，在筛选结束前超过 GimmBO，并在精炼开始后不久超过 Stylus+GimmBO，最终达到最高的相似度。 Stylus+GimmBO 是最强的替代方法，并受益于由 GT 导出的自动描述以支持检索。 Stylus 单独使用时起步较快，但很快在 0.80 0.80 附近趋于停滞，而 GimmBO 提升较为平缓，随机坐标下降法始终处于最低水平。 相对于推理次数而言，排序基本相似，但 HimmBO 的优势更为明显，因为筛选不需要生成图像。 HimmBO 仅经过 8 次推理就达到 0.80 0.80，而 Stylus+GimmBO 需要 53 次，GimmBO 需要 117 次；Stylus 和随机坐标下降法始终未能达到这一水平。 HimmBO 的一次会话在 64 次推理后停止，虚线延续部分显示在与对比方法相同的推理预算下仍能进一步提升。 稀疏性恢复进一步解释了这些差异。 HimmBO 恢复的 GT 适配器最多，其次是 Stylus+GimmBO，其后续搜索无法恢复 Stylus 遗漏的组件。 Stylus 单独使用时能恢复一些 GT 组件，而 GimmBO 尽管图像相似度中等，却几乎无法恢复任何组件。 相反，GimmBO 会提升视觉上相似的替代项以逼近目标，但在 N = 360 N{=}360 时仍无法达到匹配。 这印证了第 3 节中关于风格空间的观察：即使恢复出的激活集是错误的，视觉上相似的适配器也可能生成相似的图像。

sents.zh: Stylus+GimmBO 是最强的替代方法，并受益于由 GT 导出的自动描述以支持检索。

sents.zh: HimmBO 恢复的 GT 适配器最多，其次是 Stylus+GimmBO，其后续搜索无法恢复 Stylus 遗漏的组件。

paragraphs.en: We next test how each method scales with library size using the nested libraries from Sec. 5.1 (Fig. 6 , right). Using the nested libraries in Fig. 6 (right), we increase N N from 40 to 1080 while keeping every target unchanged, so each larger library adds only distractor adapters, isolating sensitivity to library size from changes in the matching task. At N = 40 N{=}40 , the scale GimmBO was designed for, HimmBO and GimmBO perform similarly, while Stylus+GimmBO coincides with GimmBO because retrieval returns the full library. As N N grows, HimmBO maintains similar similarity, while Stylus+GimmBO degrades but remains the strongest alternative and GimmBO drops sharply. Stylus stays nearly flat across library sizes, while random coordinate descent remains low. Sparsity recovery explains these trends. HimmBO recovers the most GT adapters at every size, although recovery declines for the two largest libraries as screening becomes harder. Stylus+GimmBO again lies in between because retrieval removes many distractors, but any GT component it misses remains unavailable to GimmBO. GimmBO’s recovery falls to near zero as the library grows because its coefficient-space surrogate cannot transfer feedback between visually similar adapters, so additional adapters act mainly as distractors. Despite HimmBO’s lower recovery at larger N N , its similarity drops much less because larger libraries also contain closer visual substitutes for missed GT components. Refinement can exploit these substitutes, a property we develop further in Sec. 5.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 接下来我们使用第 5.1 节中的嵌套库测试每种方法如何随库规模扩展（图 6，右）。 利用图 6（右）中的嵌套库，我们将 N 从 40 增加到 1080，同时保持所有目标不变，因此更大的库只添加干扰适配器，从而将对库规模的敏感性与匹配任务的变化隔离开来。 在 N = 40 时，即 GimmBO 设计所针对的规模，HimmBO 与 GimmBO 表现相近，而 Stylus+GimmBO 与 GimmBO 重合，因为检索返回了整个库。 随着 N 增大，HimmBO 保持了相似的相似度，而 Stylus+GimmBO 有所下降但仍然是最强的替代方法，GimmBO 则急剧下降。 Stylus 在各库规模下几乎保持平稳，而随机坐标下降始终保持较低水平。 稀疏性恢复解释了这些趋势。 HimmBO 在每个规模下都恢复了最多的真实适配器（GT adapters），尽管随着筛选变得更困难，在两个最大的库中恢复率有所下降。 Stylus+GimmBO 同样介于两者之间，因为检索移除了许多干扰项，但它遗漏的任何真实组件（GT component）对 GimmBO 来说仍然不可用。 随着库增大，GimmBO 的恢复率降至接近零，因为其系数空间代理无法在视觉相似的适配器之间传递反馈，所以额外添加的适配器主要充当干扰项。 尽管 HimmBO 在较大的 N 下恢复率较低，但其相似度下降幅度小得多，因为更大的库中还包含与遗漏的真实组件（GT component）视觉上更接近的替代品。 精炼可以利用这些替代品，我们在第 5.2 节中进一步阐述这一特性。

sents.en: We next test how each method scales with library size using the nested libraries from Sec. 5.1 (Fig. 6 , right).
sents.zh: 接下来我们使用第 5.1 节中的嵌套库测试每种方法如何随库规模扩展（图 6，右）。

sents.en: Using the nested libraries in Fig. 6 (right), we increase N N from 40 to 1080 while keeping every target unchanged, so each larger library adds only distractor adapters, isolating sensitivity to library size from changes in the matching task.
sents.zh: 利用图 6（右）中的嵌套库，我们将 N 从 40 增加到 1080，同时保持所有目标不变，因此更大的库只添加干扰适配器，从而将对库规模的敏感性与匹配任务的变化隔离开来。

sents.en: At N = 40 N{=}40 , the scale GimmBO was designed for, HimmBO and GimmBO perform similarly, while Stylus+GimmBO coincides with GimmBO because retrieval returns the full library.
sents.zh: 在 N = 40 时，即 GimmBO 设计所针对的规模，HimmBO 与 GimmBO 表现相近，而 Stylus+GimmBO 与 GimmBO 重合，因为检索返回了整个库。

sents.en: As N N grows, HimmBO maintains similar similarity, while Stylus+GimmBO degrades but remains the strongest alternative and GimmBO drops sharply.
sents.zh: 随着 N 增大，HimmBO 保持了相似的相似度，而 Stylus+GimmBO 有所下降但仍然是最强的替代方法，GimmBO 则急剧下降。

sents.en: Stylus stays nearly flat across library sizes, while random coordinate descent remains low.
sents.zh: Stylus 在各库规模下几乎保持平稳，而随机坐标下降始终保持较低水平。

sents.en: Sparsity recovery explains these trends.
sents.zh: 稀疏性恢复解释了这些趋势。

sents.en: HimmBO recovers the most GT adapters at every size, although recovery declines for the two largest libraries as screening becomes harder.
sents.zh: HimmBO 在每个规模下都恢复了最多的真实适配器（GT adapters），尽管随着筛选变得更困难，在两个最大的库中恢复率有所下降。

sents.en: Stylus+GimmBO again lies in between because retrieval removes many distractors, but any GT component it misses remains unavailable to GimmBO.
sents.zh: Stylus+GimmBO 同样介于两者之间，因为检索移除了许多干扰项，但它遗漏的任何真实组件（GT component）对 GimmBO 来说仍然不可用。

sents.en: GimmBO’s recovery falls to near zero as the library grows because its coefficient-space surrogate cannot transfer feedback between visually similar adapters, so additional adapters act mainly as distractors.
sents.zh: 随着库增大，GimmBO 的恢复率降至接近零，因为其系数空间代理无法在视觉相似的适配器之间传递反馈，所以额外添加的适配器主要充当干扰项。

sents.en: Despite HimmBO’s lower recovery at larger N N , its similarity drops much less because larger libraries also contain closer visual substitutes for missed GT components.
sents.zh: 尽管 HimmBO 在较大的 N 下恢复率较低，但其相似度下降幅度小得多，因为更大的库中还包含与遗漏的真实组件（GT component）视觉上更接近的替代品。

sents.en: Refinement can exploit these substitutes, a property we develop further in Sec. 5.2 .
sents.zh: 精炼可以利用这些替代品，我们在第 5.2 节中进一步阐述这一特性。

paragraphs.en: We ablate using our simulated matching task with N = 360 N=360 for our screening and refinement stages respectively.

paragraphs.en: Following Sec. 4.3.2 , we compare UCB, ALM [ Mac92 , SWGO00 ] , and straddle as representative acquisition rules for BO, AL, and LSE, respectively (Fig. 7 ). At N = 360 N{=}360 , UCB improves fastest initially but plateaus as it concentrates on an early high-preference region. ALM explores more broadly and improves more steadily. Straddle spends its early rounds resolving uncertain level-set membership, then overtakes both before our twelve-round screening budget ends and achieves the highest recovery. The dashed continuation beyond twelve rounds shows how these trends continue past the session budget. At N = 40 N{=}40 , all three rules perform similarly because twelve rounds expose much of the library, but their differences grow with library size and straddle leads from N = 360 N{=}360 onward. This supports our use of LSE for screening: it spends several early rounds identifying promising regions, but becomes increasingly valuable once the library is too large to explore directly.

paragraphs.en: We ablate four refinement components while fixing the screening result so every variant starts from the same active set. Removing the style kernel reduces similarity because feedback can no longer transfer between visually similar adapters. Fixing the stick length to B B , as in GimmBO, causes the largest loss by concentrating search near the cap rather than covering the broader range of total strengths seen in community merges. Removing the diversity term has almost no effect on similarity, as intended, because it diversifies each batch rather than improving the optimum directly. Without it, coefficient-space exploration can produce different merges with nearly identical styles, while the diversity term spreads them in style space (Fig. 7 , right). Finally, discarding screening comparisons also reduces similarity, showing that refinement benefits from carrying earlier feedback into the reduced search space.
paragraphs.zh: 在固定筛选结果的前提下，我们对四个细化组件进行消融实验，使每个变体都从相同的活跃集合出发。 移除风格核会降低相似度，因为反馈无法再在使用视觉相似适配器的智能体之间传递。 像 GimmBO 那样将木棍长度固定为 B B 会造成最大的性能损失，因为它把搜索集中在接近上限的区域，而没有覆盖社区合并中出现的更广的总强度范围。 移除多样性项对相似度几乎没有影响，这正是预期的结果，因为它使每个批次内部多样化，而不是直接改进最优解。 没有它时，系数空间的探索可能产生风格几乎完全相同的不同合并，而多样性项则将它们在风格空间中分散开（图 7，右）。 最后，舍弃筛选比较也会降低相似度，这表明细化过程受益于将早期反馈带入缩减后的搜索空间。

paragraphs.zh: 我们探索了HimmBO的三种扩展。 每种扩展都建立在5.1节的默认设置和风格图编码任意图像的能力之上，其余会话参数保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The targets in Sec. 5.1 are built from adapters in the library, but a user’s desired style may have no exact match. To test this, we remove one GT component from the library for each target and rerun the same session. HimmBO still approximates the target by substituting a visually similar adapter for the missing component (Fig. 8 ). How well this works depends on the substitute: when sufficiently similar, the final merge still reaches a rough match (DreamSim above 0.9 0.9 ). As the library grows, screening faces more distractors, but denser style coverage also makes closer substitutes more likely.
paragraphs.zh: 第5.1节中的目标由库中的适配器构建而成，但用户期望的风格可能没有完全匹配的适配器。 为验证这一点，我们对每个目标从库中移除一个真值（GT）组件，并重新运行相同的会话。 HimmBO 仍能通过用一个视觉上相似的适配器替代缺失的组件来近似目标（图8）。 效果好坏取决于替代组件：当替代者足够相似时，最终合并仍能达到大致匹配（DreamSim 高于 0.9 0.9）。 随着库的增长，筛选面临更多干扰项，但更密集的风格覆盖也使得找到更接近的替代组件的可能性更大。

paragraphs.en: A user may already have reference images that indicate their preferred style before interaction begins. We use these images to initialize the preference model by averaging their representations into a single target for a simulated user and collecting three rounds of screening feedback. The subsequent interaction is otherwise unchanged, except that the user completes only T 1 = 9 T_{1}=9 screening rounds instead of the default 12 12 . The references therefore guide early discovery while leaving the full adapter library available for exploration (Fig. 9 ). Screening then proceeds normally, without restricting the search to the neighborhood of the references.
paragraphs.zh: 用户在交互开始前可能已经拥有能够表明其偏好风格的参考图像。 我们利用这些图像来初始化偏好模型：将其表示平均为模拟用户的单一目标，并收集三轮筛选反馈。 除此之外，后续交互保持不变，只是用户仅需完成 T 1 = 9 T_{1}=9 轮筛选，而非默认的 12 12 轮。 因此，参考图像可以引导早期发现，同时保留完整的适配器库供探索（图 9 ）。 随后筛选正常进行，不会将搜索限制在参考图像的邻域内。

paragraphs.en: We initialize the screening pool with single-adapter samples because they reliably produce valid, high-quality images. Generic space-filling sampling over multi-adapter coefficients can instead produce many poor-quality combinations, as observed by previous work [ LLJ26 ] . Refinement provides a better source of multi-adapter samples: every delivered merge has already produced a valid image and been preferred by a user. Because its coefficients and style feature are also known, we can add it directly to the screening pool without training a new adapter or generating another image (Fig. 10 ). In a preliminary experiment, adding such merges increases the mean final similarity from 0.923 0.923 to 0.944 0.944 (App. E ). Over time, these user-vetted multi-adapter samples could improve future screening with little additional acquisition overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用单适配器样本来初始化筛选池，因为它们能够可靠地生成有效且高质量的图像。 如先前工作 [ LLJ26 ] 所观察到的，在多适配器系数上进行通用的空间填充采样反而可能产生许多低质量的组合。 精化过程为多适配器样本提供了更好的来源：每一次交付的合并都已经生成过有效图像并被用户所偏好。 由于其系数和风格特征也是已知的，我们可以直接将其加入筛选池，而无需训练新的适配器或生成另一幅图像（图 10 ）。 在一个初步实验中，加入此类合并使最终平均相似度从 0.923 0.923 提升到 0.944 0.944（附录 E ）。 随着时间推移，这些经用户审核的多适配器样本只需少量额外的采集开销，就能改进未来的筛选。

Screening itself is independent of the merging rule because its gallery contains only single-adapter images, so alternative rules [ MR22 , YTC∗23 , YYY∗24 ] would affect refinement alone and are straightforward to explore in future work.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation relies on simulated preference feedback. GimmBO’s user study found DreamSim to be a good proxy for human judgments in the same matching task [ LLJ26 ] , supporting its use for controlled comparisons here. We additionally conducted a small preliminary test with real users while measuring session cost (App. A.6 ); across these multi-round sessions, HimmBO found better merges than GimmBO while completing the interaction faster. Our simulated user, however, provides noise-free and internally consistent feedback, whereas real users may be inconsistent or change their preferences during a session. A larger user study is needed to measure how often this occurs and whether it causes screening to select the wrong adapters or refinement to become less stable. These effects could motivate preference models that are more robust to noisy or drifting feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估依赖于模拟的偏好反馈。 GimmBO 的用户研究发现 DreamSim 在相同的匹配任务中能很好地代替人类判断 [ LLJ26 ]，这支持了在此处将其用于受控比较。 我们还进行了小规模的真实用户初步测试，同时测量会话成本（附录 A.6 ）；在这些多轮会话中，HimmBO 找到了比 GimmBO 更好的合并方案，并且更快地完成了交互。 然而，我们的模拟用户提供的是无噪声且内部一致的反馈，而真实用户可能前后不一致，或会在会话过程中改变其偏好。 需要更大规模的用户研究来衡量这种情况发生的频率，以及它是否会导致筛选选出错误的适配器，或使精炼过程变得不那么稳定。 这些影响可能促使我们构建对噪声或漂移反馈更鲁棒的偏好模型。

paragraphs.en: Our adaptation uses only part of the standard LSE formulation. Standard LSE assumes scalar Gaussian observations and intersects confidence intervals across rounds to bound a fixed latent function on a common scale [ GCHK13 ] . Our utilities are instead inferred from comparisons and the posterior is refit each round, so confidence intervals from different rounds are not directly comparable. We therefore use straddle and the per-round level-set partition, but omit interval intersection and related components. Extending these ideas to preferential feedback, including more recent level-set methods, is an interesting direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的改编方法只使用了标准 LSE 公式的一部分。 标准 LSE 假设观测为标量高斯观测，并通过跨轮次对置信区间求交集，在共同尺度上界定一个固定的潜在函数 [ GCHK13 ] 。 我们的效用则是从比较中推断的，且后验在每一轮都会重新拟合，因此不同轮次的置信区间不能直接比较。 因此我们使用 straddle 策略和每轮的水平集划分，但省略了区间求交及相关组件。 将这些想法扩展到偏好反馈，包括更近期的水平集方法，是未来工作的一个有趣方向。

paragraphs.en: The style map suppresses content shared across gallery images but does not remove it completely, so a reference image with different content may retrieve the wrong style neighbors. A representation that separates style and content more explicitly could make personalization more reliable across subjects. The transition from screening to refinement is also one-way, so an adapter omitted from the active set cannot be recovered later. Revisiting the full library as refinement progresses could correct such misses and make the two stages interact more tightly. paragraphs.en: Adapters also inherit and can amplify the harms of generative image models. A large part of what Civitai hosts exists to sexualize women, and a session can start from any photograph, so the same search machinery can be applied to a real person who never consented to it. paragraphs.en: We omit the remaining components of the standard LSE formulation [ GCHK13 ] , whose assumptions do not carry over to preferential feedback. Standard LSE observes noisy scalar values of a fixed function f f under a Gaussian likelihood with fixed kernel hyperparameters, yielding an exact posterior whose intervals across rounds bound the same f f on a common scale. Our posterior is instead inferred from comparisons through a Laplace approximation, with hyperparameters re-fit every round, so its utility scale can change across rounds. Standard LSE intersects intervals across rounds and schedules β \beta so that they jointly cover f f . Because our intervals are not comparable across rounds, we keep β \beta fixed, do not intersect intervals, and allow classified adapters to be reconsidered. Its batch variant also spreads queries by updating the variance as if pending observations were already available, which relies on Gaussian observations. We instead separate each batch using the style radius of Sec. 4.3.2 . Finally, standard LSE stops once the classification is ε \varepsilon -accurate, whereas we stop after a fixed budget of T 1 T_{1} rounds to bound user interaction time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们省略标准 LSE 公式 [GCHK13] 的其余组成部分，因为其假设不适用于偏好反馈。 标准LSE在固定核超参数下通过高斯似然观测固定函数 f f 的带噪标量值，从而得到一个精确后验，其各轮的区间在同一尺度上界定同一个 f f。 我们的后验则通过拉普拉斯近似从比较中推断得出，且超参数在每轮都重新拟合，因此其效用尺度可能在不同轮次间发生变化。 标准LSE对各轮的区间取交集，并调度 β \beta，使二者共同覆盖 f f。 由于我们的区间在不同轮次间不可比较，我们保持 β \beta 固定，不对区间取交集，并允许已分类的适配器被重新考虑。 其批量变体还通过把待处理观测当作已经可用来更新方差，从而分散查询，这依赖于高斯观测。 我们则使用第 4.3.2 节的风格半径来分离每个批次。 最后，标准LSE在分类达到 ε \varepsilon 精度后停止，而我们在固定的 T 1 T_{1} 轮预算后停止，以限制用户交互时间。

paragraphs.en: We report wall-clock time per round (Table S4 ) and per session (Fig. S3 ) on a single H100 GPU with the N = 360 N{=}360 library, averaged over ten sessions done by two novice users. During refinement, each round generates q q merges, while posterior updating and acquisition optimization take about 1 1 s compared with about 35 35 s for image generation. Thus, in both stages, user-facing latency is dominated by image generation or the user’s own judgment rather than search computation. On average, generation takes 4.4 4.4 s per image in HimmBO and 5.7 5.7 s in GimmBO because HimmBO refines only over the m = 8 m{=}8 selected adapters, which remain in memory, whereas GimmBO searches the full library and often needs to load adapters from storage. A HimmBO session takes about 15 15 minutes, compared with 37 37 minutes for GimmBO. Most of this difference comes from screening, whose 12 12 rounds require no image generation; the remainder comes from shorter user judgment per round and faster model fitting, which takes about ten seconds per round for GimmBO under its SAAS prior (Sec. A.1 ). Participants who used both methods reported that HimmBO performs better than GimmBO.

paragraphs.en: On August 18, 2026, we queried the public Civitai API for LoRA adapters tagged style with SDXL 1.0 as the base model, obtaining 9,909 adapters. Table S5 lists how many adapters remain after each curation step of Sec. 5.1 . Adapters for derived base models such as Pony and Illustrious rarely work on SDXL and are excluded. We keep adapters with at least 1,000 downloads and drop those whose tags or names indicate content other than style, such as characters, clothing, poses, detail enhancers, and sliders, as well as those lacking a downloadable SDXL version or a preview image. We also retain all adapters from GimmBO’s library that are still online. Because tags cannot distinguish a style from an adapter that adds content, a language model (Claude Haiku) reads each remaining adapter’s name, tags, trigger words, and description, keeping only those that change how an image looks rather than what it shows. paragraphs.en: The 24 24 ground-truth (GT) targets cover the four subject types used by the gallery prompts (a person, an animal, a still life, and a landscape) with six targets each. Their prompts will be released with the code. Half of the GT targets are generated from hidden merges of two library adapters and half from three, the most common merge sizes in community use and small enough for each component’s style to remain distinguishable. Their total strengths are drawn from the empirical distribution of community merges, using the same usage statistics as in Sec. A.4 . paragraphs.en: For Stylus [ LWT∗24 ] , we rebuild the retrieval index on our library rather than using Stylus’s own adapter index.
